summary: MicroVision, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $42 million under an existing $150 million sales agreement with Deutsche Bank, Mizuho, and Craig-Hallum. The filing is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation. Shares trade on Nasdaq at $0.36. Agents receive 3% commission; no other deal terms disclosed. This is a capital-raising vehicle, not a transformative event or structural change.
